title: Empty
description: x-empty renders an empty-state placeholder in its host: an icon, a message heading and an optional description line.

icon.description: Icon or emoji shown above the message.

message.description: The heading. The text between the tags wins; this fills an empty host.

description.description: A smaller line under the heading. Left out when empty.
